proposals.title: Item 4 – Shareholder Proposal – Shareholder Approval of By-Law Amendments
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board amend bylaws so any board-approved bylaw amendment is subject to a non-binding shareholder vote unless already subject to a binding shareholder vote.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 5 – Shareholder Proposal – Report on Incentive-Based Compensation and Risks of Material Losses
proposals.proponent: Comptroller of the State of New York, Thomas P. DiNapoli, Trustee of the New York State Common Retirement Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether and how the Company identifies employees eligible for incentive pay tied to metrics that could expose it to material losses, with related breakdowns.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 6 – Shareholder Proposal – Report on Global Median Pay Gap
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Julia Bamburg and Judith Bamburg, as trustees of the Harold B. Bamburg Revocable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender/racial pay gap, including associated policy, reputational, competitive, and operational risks, and recruiting and retention risks.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
